title: MemoryReflectionsListRequest
description: List reflections newest-first. stale is computed at read time; reflections referencing any tombstoned record are excluded (§6.9). Grant: reflect or admin covering each returned reflection pinned selection/filter. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

selection.description: Optional; restricts listing to reflections this selection covers.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
